Name: garbage_collector
Author: loogooter
Description: Simply removes items added to inventory that are categorized as trash and have no sell value. For instance, if you were fishing and you got a piece of broken glasses, it would automatically trash it, however if you got something like a Joja-Cola or seaweed or anything with value, it would leave it alone.

Manifest.Name: garbage_collector
Manifest.Description: Removes Trash Items from your inventory if they have no sell value
Manifest.Author: OlegSilkin
